DB Regio · Dovetail Games · TCA Quadrant Airbus

DB BR 440

Cab setup

  • Insert master key (PARK BRK)
  • Set reverser to neutral
  • Raise pantograph, close MCB
  • Turn on PZB and SiFa
  • Set headlights
  • Open doors

Cleared to depart

  • Close doors
  • Check signal
  • Set reverser to forward
  • Train brake to Drive
  • Apply power

Controller
